subject: Sandbox provisioning & MAP milestone: environment readiness checklist
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Torres <rachel@medicor.com>, Dan Li <dli@medicor.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox provisioning & MAP milestone: environment readiness checklist

Hi Rachel / Dan —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Per our call, I pulled together a short checklist for the sandbox (POC) environment so we can lock the MAP milestone for "POC environment ready". Please review and flag any items that need different owners or timelines.

High-level milestones we agreed on:
- Network connectivity: VPC peering + routing (target: dev subnet reachable from Redwood demo infra) — owner: Medicor infra
- IP allowlist: outbound IPs for API access + any inbound ports — owner: Medicor network
- SSO / SAML: test IdP integration (Okta) for SSO into the Redwood console — owner: Medicor IAM
- Secrets / KMS: key access model and delegated secrets (KMS role) for model keys — owner: Medicor security; Redwood assists with IAM policy template
- Smoke tests & validation: sample inference calls, tokenized load test, and egress verification — owner: Redwood (Ben)

I attached a workbook with the milestone checklist and proposed target dates. Suggested MAP close target for the POC: 6 weeks from today (2026-11-09), assuming no blockers on peering or SSO. If network or procurement requires more lead time, call that out and we can adjust the MAP accordingly.

Next steps — please reply with: 1) confirmed owners for each bullet, 2) any procurement constraints (e.g., IP allowlist windows), and 3) preferred test window.

Attachments: sandbox-provisioning-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
From: Rachel Torres <rachel@medicor.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dan Li <dli@medicor.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox provisioning & MAP milestone: environment readiness checklist

Karthik —

Appreciate the recap and clear checklist. Quick confirmations from our side:
- VPC peering + routing: Dan will own this. ETA: initial peering request submitted by 2026-10-04; full routing/tests targeted by 2026-10-11.
- IP allowlist: Procurement requires a change window and approval — I expect procurement can sign off by 2026-10-08 if we provide the IP ranges and justification today.
- SSO/SAML (Okta): I will own the application config; our Okta team needs the SAML metadata and ACS URL from Redwood. ETA: config done by 2026-10-06.
- Secrets / KMS: Security will want to review the KMS access pattern. Can Redwood share the IAM role template and the KMS key policy?

Two constraints to flag:
1) Procurement has a monthly maintenance blackout from 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-18 — they won't approve network changes during that window.
2) We need a one-hour maintenance window for the peering test where services may report transient errors; please give us two alternate slots.

I'll coordinate with Procurement and confirm owners formally by tomorrow. For the SAML metadata: can you send that over?

Thanks,
Rachel Torres
Sr. Product Manager — Medicor Health
rachel@medicor.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Torres <rachel@medicor.com>, Dan Li <dli@medicor.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox provisioning & MAP milestone: environment readiness checklist

Thanks Rachel — this is perfect and helpful.

Action items from Redwood:
- I attached the SAML metadata and ACS URL in the Drive link (see MAP doc). Also attaching our suggested IAM role template and a short KMS key-policy example for Medicor's security review.
- Ben will run the smoke tests once peering and IP allowlist are in place; proposed test slots: 2026-10-12 09:00-10:00 PT or 2026-10-19 13:00-14:00 PT (Ben, any preference?).
- We will pause any tests during procurement blackout (noted).

Ben (cc): please review the checklist sheet — add any infra validations you think we should include (e.g., DNS reachability, MTU check, egress IP confirmation).

Attachments referenced: kms-integration-guidance.pdf (pdf)

If Medicor confirms the owners and the 2026-10-04 peering kickoff, we'll keep the MAP milestone target of 2026-11-09. If peering or procurement slips past 2026-10-18, we'll propose shifting the MAP milestone to 2026-11-23.

Karthik
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Torres <rachel@medicor.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox provisioning & MAP milestone: environment readiness checklist

Rachel / team — quick infra note:
- I added two validation steps to the checklist: (1) KV cache persistence sanity check under a 1k token load, (2) TLS cipher verification against your load balancer.
- Prefer the 2026-10-19 13:00-14:00 PT slot for the smoke run to avoid the 10/12 procurement blackout.

I'll coordinate with your network lead (Dan) on test IPs and will post the final runbook in the Drive link once ready.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
